ED Questions Jai Anmol Ambani in Yes Bank Probe, Delhi HC Scraps Union Bank Fraud Tag

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has questioned Jai Anmol Ambani, a son of Reliance Industries' chairman Mukesh Ambani's brother Anil Ambani, in connection with the Yes Bank probe. The Delhi High Court has scrapped the fraud tag on Union Bank, which was previously linked to the probe. This development comes as part of the ED's ongoing investigation into alleged fund diversion and money laundering related to Reliance Industries' subsidiaries.
